title: ISM Manufacturing PMI spot-check values
description: Headline PMI values read by hand out of the prose of ISM's monthly Report on Business releases, then compared by scripts/reconcile-ism.ts against the merged series this site publishes. Tolerance is 0.5 because ISM reports to one decimal. These exist for months a single source carries: where both the Wayback archive and the curated/PRNewswire series hold a month, reconcile-ism.ts cross-checks them automatically and no manual entry is needed. Seed at acquisition-path boundaries — a scraper regression corrupts values per URL era, so one anchor per era catches it.

entries.note: First month of the series. Legacy ism.ws/MfgROB.cfm era — a single rotating page where the snapshot timestamp, not the URL, determines the month, so a mis-dated capture would silently attribute the wrong value. Prose: "The September PMI registered 56.6 percent".
Last month before the structural 2015-04 to 2020-05 archive gap. Legacy ism.ws era. Prose: "The March PMI registered 51.5 percent".
First month after the structural gap, and the first on the ismworld.org per-month URL scheme. Prose: "The June PMI registered 52.6 percent".

Last month on the /ism-report-on-business/ path. ISM renamed the segment to /ism-pmi-reports/ immediately after, which silently stalled both scrapers here until 2026-08. Prose: "The Manufacturing PMI registered 48 percent in July".
First month recovered from the renamed /ism-pmi-reports/ path. Prose: "The Manufacturing PMI registered 49.1 percent in September".
